quotes.text: Above & Beyond have carved out a distinctive place in the electronic music world through their lush, atmospheric soundscapes that seamlessly blend ambient textures with uplifting melodies. Their music transcends the dancefloor, crafting immersive emotional journeys that feel more like storytelling than standard club tracks.
The British trio has been making music together since 2000; over the past twenty-four years, they have become pioneers in the trance and progressive house scenes.
With their latest album, Bigger Than All Of Us, Above & Beyond fully capture the signature sounds that have defined their career, blending ambient serenity with uplifting melodic textures.

"Quicksand (Don't Go)," captures the emotional depth that Above & Beyond are known for, weaving heartfelt lyrics and carefully crafted melodies with their signature blend of trance and electronic dance elements.

"Here Before" showcases the group's versatility while staying rooted in the emotional resonance that defines their work, departing from their traditional trance sound while leaning into a more familiar style of dance music with an underground edge.

This album reflects a mature approach to their craft, where every note feels intentional and invites listeners to not just hear the music, but feel it. With this sixteen-track project, Above & Beyond deliver a body of work that stays true to the sound longtime fans know and love, rooted in trance and electronic textures, while pushing their artistry further by experimenting with expansive soundscapes and emotional depth.
Sonically, the album is rooted in classic Above & Beyond trademarks – soaring synths, earnest vocals, and moments that build into cathartic release – yet, it doesn't shy away from vulnerability.

Other collaborations with artists such as Malou, Opposite The Other and Oliver Smith inject fresh energy, particularly on tracks like Letting Go and Here Before, which straddle trance and indie-dance with finesse.
The album is thoughtfully paced, alternating between euphoric peaks and reflective valleys. This is a record designed to be experienced front to back, not cherry picked for singles.

Bigger Than All Of Us is more than a return to form, it's a reminder of what makes Above & Beyond such a beloved force in electronic music. There's a sense of gratitude woven through every lyric and melody, a recognition that music can still move people in profound ways.
